desc: Analyze problem constraints and conditions (prefix property for rows/cols).
Identify that minimal $R_r$ and $C_c$ values are derived from black cells, and white cells impose upper-bound-like constraints.
Determine that propagation is needed: increasing $R_r$ may force $C_c$ to increase, and vice versa.
Select Segment Tree with Lazy Propagation (or similar) to handle range max updates and point queries efficiently given $N \le 10^9$.
Implement reading input and computing initial $R_r^{min}$ and $C_c^{min}$.
Implement a coordinate compression or dynamic segment tree for range max-update and point query.
Implement the propagation loop: when $R_r$ increases, update range $[1, R_r]$ in $C$ tree with $r$. When $C_c$ increases, update range $[1, C_c]$ in $R$ tree with $c$.
After convergence, check all white cells against the final $R$ and $C$.
